children: Z Squared closed its purchase of Paradox Data, issuing $5 million of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at closing. To ensure a smooth transition at the El Dorado, Arkansas campus, the parties entered a $1-per-year triple net lease with a one-time relocation payment capped at $500,000, and a power access and cost-sharing pact to manage transfer of up to 8,000 kVA service pending utility consent. An assignment of membership interests made Z Squared the sole member of Paradox Data, supporting the company's plan to develop AI-ready capacity over time.
